2: A song. A Psalm of the sons of Korah. For the choirmaster. According to Mahalath Leannoth. A Maskil of Heman the Ezrahite. O LORD, the God of my salvation, day and night I cry out before You.
3: May my prayer come before You; incline Your ear to my cry.
4: For my soul is full of troubles, and my life draws near to Sheol.
5: I am counted among those descending to the Pit. I am like a man without strength.
6: I am forsaken among the dead, like the slain who lie in the grave, whom You remember no more, who are cut off from Your care.
7: You have laid me in the lowest Pit, in the darkest of the depths.
8: Your wrath weighs heavily upon me; all Your waves have submerged me. Selah
9: You have removed my friends from me; You have made me repulsive to them; I am confined and cannot escape.
10: My eyes grow dim with grief. I call to You daily, O LORD; I spread out my hands to You.
11: Do You work wonders for the dead? Do departed spirits rise up to praise You? Selah
12: Can Your loving devotion be proclaimed in the grave, Your faithfulness in Abaddon?
13: Will Your wonders be known in the darkness, or Your righteousness in the land of oblivion?
14: But to You, O LORD, I cry for help; in the morning my prayer comes before You.
15: Why, O LORD, do You reject me? Why do You hide Your face from me?
16: From my youth I was afflicted and near death. I have borne Your terrors; I am in despair.
17: Your wrath has swept over me; Your terrors have destroyed me.
18: All day long they engulf me like water; they enclose me on every side.
19: You have removed my beloved and my friend; darkness is my closest companion.
